title: Reno Wildfire Progresses as Thousands Face Evacuation Orders
subtitle: Firefighters gain ground against the Hawk Fire while officials investigate its human-caused origins.

summary.en: The Hawk Fire near Reno, Nevada, is now 27% contained after burning over 15,000 acres. Authorities have reduced the number of people under immediate evacuation orders as the situation stabilizes. At least 38 properties have been damaged or destroyed, and seven people have been injured. Officials confirmed the fire was caused by human activity, though the exact circumstances remain under investigation. Governor Joe Lombardo has declared a state of emergency to bring in extra help from the National Guard.
summary.zh: 位於內華達州雷諾市附近的「鷹火」在燒毀超過一萬五千英畝土地後，目前已控制百分之二十七。隨著情況趨於穩定，當局已減少處於立即撤離命令下的人數。至少有三十八處房產受損或被毀，七人受傷。官員證實火災由人為活動引起，確切情況仍在調查中。州長隆巴多已宣布進入緊急狀態，以調動國民兵提供額外協助。

paragraphs.en: The fast-moving Hawk Fire, which has threatened neighborhoods in Reno, Nevada, for several days, is now about 27% contained, according to local authorities. As of Monday afternoon, the fire had burned more than 15,000 acres. While the situation remains dangerous, officials reported an improvement in the number of residents affected by safety orders. Currently, 23,000 people are under a “go-now” order, and 40,000 are under a “get-set” warning. This is a significant change from Monday morning, when 90,000 people were under evacuation orders or warnings.
paragraphs.zh: 根據當地官員指出，在內華達州雷諾市（Reno）威脅當地社區多日的「鷹火」（Hawk Fire）目前已控制約百分之二十七。截至週一下午，這場大火已燒毀超過一萬五千英畝的土地。雖然情況依然危險，但官員表示受安全命令影響的居民人數有所改善。目前有兩萬三千人處於「立即撤離」命令下，另有四萬人處於「準備撤離」警告中。這與週一上午的情況相比有顯著變化，當時有九萬人處於撤離命令或警告範圍內。

paragraphs.en: Richard Edwards, the chief of the Truckee Meadows Fire Protection District, stated that more than 900 personnel are working to control the blaze. Damage assessment teams have identified 32 destroyed homes and six damaged properties, though officials expect these numbers to rise as they continue to inspect the area. While there have been no deaths reported, authorities confirmed that four civilians and three firefighters have suffered injuries since the fire began on Saturday.
paragraphs.zh: 特拉基草甸消防區（Truckee Meadows Fire Protection District）局長理查．愛德華茲（Richard Edwards）表示，目前有超過九百名人員正致力於控制火勢。損害評估小組已確認有三十二棟房屋被毀、六處房產受損，但官員預計隨著檢查工作的持續，這些數字可能會上升。雖然目前沒有死亡報告，但當局證實自週六火災發生以來，已有四名平民和三名消防員受傷。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the fire started to the northwest of Reno and grew rapidly due to strong winds and dry conditions. These “red flag” conditions—which include warm temperatures, low humidity, and high winds—made the fire difficult to manage. Sheriff Darin Balaam of Washoe County described the scene on Saturday night as “extremely confusing,” noting that changing winds caused the fire to move in unpredictable directions, sometimes jumping over fire trucks. The fire is the third major wildfire to hit northern Nevada in just two weeks, all of which officials say were caused by human activity.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，這場火災始於雷諾市西北方，由於強風和乾燥的環境，火勢迅速蔓延。這些包括高溫、低濕度和強風在內的「紅旗」條件，使得火勢難以控制。瓦肖郡（Washoe County）警長達林．巴拉姆（Darin Balaam）形容週六晚間的現場「極度混亂」，並指出變幻莫測的風向導致火勢朝不可預測的方向移動，有時甚至會越過消防車。這是兩週內北內華達州發生的第三起重大野火，官員表示這些火災皆由人為活動引起。

paragraphs.en: “We do know that the fire was human-caused,” Chief Edwards said. “We do not know if it was intentional or unintentional.” The investigation into the exact cause is ongoing. To help manage the crisis, Nevada Governor Joe Lombardo declared a state of emergency in Washoe County. This action allowed the state to bring in the National Guard, including two helicopters and 60 troops, to assist with security and firefighting efforts. NPR reports that the governor urged residents to remain alert and follow the directions of local officials as the situation continues to evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 愛德華茲局長表示：「我們確實知道這場火災是人為造成的，但我們不確定是有意還是無意。」針對確切起火原因的調查仍在進行中。為了協助處理危機，內華達州州長喬．隆巴多（Joe Lombardo）宣布瓦肖郡進入緊急狀態。此舉使該州得以調動國民兵（National Guard），包括兩架直升機和六十名士兵，以協助安全維護與滅火工作。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，州長敦促居民保持警覺，並在局勢持續演變時遵循當地官員的指示。

paragraphs.en: For many residents, the experience has been stressful and chaotic. Ruby Delatorre, a local resident, told reporters that she felt like she was in a movie when she discovered her home was in an evacuation zone. Others, like Cari Kieffer, described the terrifying experience of having only minutes to pack essential items before fleeing their homes. While some evacuation orders are beginning to lift, the sheriff’s department has asked residents to avoid hiking or flying drones in the area, as these activities can interfere with the work of firefighting crews.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多居民而言，這段經歷充滿壓力且混亂。當地居民露比．德拉托雷（Ruby Delatorre）告訴記者，當她發現自己的家位於撤離區時，感覺就像身處電影情節中。其他人如卡莉．基弗（Cari Kieffer）則描述了在逃離家園前只有幾分鐘時間打包必需品的恐怖經歷。雖然部分撤離命令已開始解除，但警長辦公室已要求居民避免在該地區進行徒步旅行或操作無人機，因為這些活動可能會干擾消防人員的工作。

paragraphs.en: Infrastructure in the region has also been heavily impacted. Nearly 10,000 homes and businesses in Washoe County were without power on Monday. Jesse Murray, the vice-president of NV Energy, explained that 11 crews are working to restore electricity as soon as it is safe to do so. Additionally, parts of US Route 395 were closed to allow emergency vehicles to move freely. While most schools in the county were closed on Monday to keep roads clear, the University of Nevada, Reno, announced that its campus would continue to operate despite being near the fire zone.
paragraphs.zh: 該地區的基礎設施也受到嚴重影響。週一時，瓦肖郡有近一萬戶家庭和企業斷電。內華達能源公司（NV Energy）副總裁傑西．莫瑞（Jesse Murray）解釋，目前有十一支隊伍正致力於在安全情況下儘速恢復供電。此外，美國三九五號公路（US Route 395）部分路段已封閉，以利緊急車輛通行。雖然郡內多數學校週一停課以保持道路暢通，但內華達大學雷諾分校（University of Nevada, Reno）宣布，儘管校區鄰近火災區，仍將維持運作。

paragraphs.en: As the region recovers, officials are emphasizing the importance of being prepared. Sheriff Balaam encouraged residents to use tools like the Watch Duty app to stay informed about real-time data on nearby disasters. With the fire now partially contained, authorities are focusing on protecting remaining properties and ensuring the safety of the community. Residents are advised to stay ready to leave at a moment's notice, as unpredictable winds could still change the path of the fire. For now, the focus remains on supporting those who have lost their homes and ensuring that the remaining hotspots are fully extinguished.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著該地區逐漸恢復，官員強調了做好準備的重要性。巴拉姆警長鼓勵居民使用如「Watch Duty」應用程式等工具，以獲取附近災情的即時數據。隨著火勢部分受到控制，當局正專注於保護剩餘房產並確保社區安全。建議居民隨時準備好在接到通知後立即撤離，因為不可預測的風向仍可能改變火勢路徑。目前，重點仍放在支援失去家園的民眾，並確保剩餘的火點被完全撲滅。

quiz.question: What was the status of the evacuation orders for Reno residents by Monday afternoon?

options.A: 90,000 people were under evacuation orders or warnings.
options.B: 23,000 people were under a 'go-now' order and 40,000 were under a 'get-set' warning.
options.C: All evacuation orders had been lifted for the residents of Washoe County.
options.D: Only 15,000 people remained under mandatory evacuation orders.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，週一下午的數據顯示 23,000 人處於「立即撤離 (go-now)」狀態，40,000 人處於「準備撤離 (get-set)」警告。選項 A 是週一早上的數據，而非下午。選項 C 與文章提到的部分撤離令解除不符，且並非全部解除。選項 D 的數字 15,000 是指燃燒的面積（英畝），而非撤離人數，屬於混淆數據的陷阱。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the firefighting efforts in the Washoe County area?

options.A: The fire is currently being managed exclusively by local Reno firefighters.
options.B: The fire was caused by natural events like lightning strikes.
options.C: The situation is still volatile, requiring residents to remain vigilant despite partial containment.
options.D: The fire has been fully extinguished, allowing all residents to return home safely.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章最後一段，儘管火勢已部分控制，但官員仍建議居民隨時準備撤離，因為不可預測的風向可能改變火勢路徑。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到州長已調派國民警衛隊協助。選項 B 錯誤，文章明確指出火災由人為因素引起。選項 D 錯誤，文章提到仍有「熱點 (hotspots)」需要撲滅，並未完全熄滅。

quiz.question: In the third paragraph, what does the word 'jump' mean in the phrase 'jumping over fire trucks'?

options.A: To move quickly across a distance, bypassing obstacles.
options.B: To increase in intensity or height significantly.
options.C: To physically leap or spring off the ground.
options.D: To change from one topic to another abruptly.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，「jumping over」形容火勢迅速蔓延，跨越了原本應能阻擋火勢的消防車，而非指火災本身具有生物性的跳躍動作。選項 B 雖然火勢會增強，但此處強調的是移動路徑。選項 C 為字面義，不適用於火災。選項 D 則是討論時轉換話題的意思，與物理空間的火勢移動無關。
